projectTitle: MegaPotato AI image upscaler API examples: image upscaling (super-resolution) x2-x8, #1 of 18 upscalers in a 2026 benchmark, cheapest of the leaders
description: Ready-to-run examples for the MegaPotato image upscaling API (megapotato.app): upscale a photo ×2, ×4 or ×8 with super-resolution from curl, Python or Node.js. In the October 2026 blind benchmark of 18 AI upscalers (open data, CC BY 4.0) the model came first and is the cheapest of the leaders: megapotato.app/blog/best-ai-image-upscalers-2026. Submit a photo, poll the job, download the result; pay per photo, free test keys. Full docs: megapotato.app/developers, OpenAPI: megapotato.app/developers/openapi.json.
rules: Send an Idempotency-Key header with every POST /v1/upscale and reuse it on retries: the same key returns the same job and charges once.
Poll GET /v1/jobs/{id}?wait=55 instead of polling every second; the server holds the request until the job finishes or 55 s pass.
Download result_url with a plain GET and no Authorization header; the link is valid for about an hour, re-read the job for a fresh one.
Price a photo first with POST /v1/quote (free); a job that fails is refunded automatically.
Keep the API key on your server, never in a web page, a mobile app or a repository; a test key (mp_test_…) exercises the whole flow without charging.
